title: Training Notes: Release at Once for Purchasers Who Use Their Gift Cards & Store Credit Card Regularly
content:
**What is released at once?** When a locked Gift Cards & Store Credit card is replaced, part of the protected balance is released at once whatever the hold, when the holder both bought the card and used it regularly. The investigation hold share then applies only to the protected balance above the amount released at once, never below zero, and the hold is rounded half up to the cent.

**Who qualifies, and for how much?**

| Holder is the purchaser of record of the Online Orders order line that bought the card | Orders the card was spent on in the last 12 months | Released at once |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 4 or more | The first 30.00 of the protected balance |
| Yes | At least 2 but fewer than 4 | The first 20.00 of the protected balance |
| Yes | Fewer than 2 | Nothing |
| No (including any card bought by someone else) | Any number | Nothing |

**How is use counted?** By the spending entries on the card's own ledger, one for each order the card paid, dated in the last 12 months (fewer than 12 whole months before the replacement date). Purchase is read from the order line on the Online Orders record that bought the card.

**What does it come to on figures?** (hypothetical cards, hypothetical hold share of 0.25)

| Protected balance | Purchaser? | Orders in 12 months | Released at once | Balance the share applies to | Hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 70.00 | Yes | 5 | 30.00 | 40.00 | 10.00 |
| 70.00 | Yes | 3 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 12.50 |
| 70.00 | No | 9 | none | 70.00 | 17.50 |
| 15.00 | Yes | 4 | 30.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | 0.00 |
